## Source: amazon-inspector (0efdeb2bf7d6e8d4071d0f6d39bbad679cbca3549d0298b6503dc3974fec20a9)
The package contains no identified install-time, import-time, or runtime behavior that would compromise an installer. No lifecycle hooks performing network I/O, no credential or filesystem reads targeting installer secrets, no outbound exfiltration endpoints, and no fetch-and-execute patterns were observed in the shipped files.

## Source: kam193 (d32ccbe0ed7b8e97acb3670d4e50b774d36520ddd91c34367170b7c5e88337e3)
This campaign consists of similar loader packages, which provide executing code from a given URL. While they do not contain the malicious payload and the usage remains unknown, they are clearly a coordinated campaign to place multiple deceptive ways to load malicious code.
